## About

Cosmicinnovation Lab is a full-service digital growth agency serving UP & Bihar, India,
specialising in website design and development, Google SEO ranking, AI and LLM search visibility,
digital marketing, WhatsApp automation, and social media management.

The agency primarily serves businesses in tier-2 and tier-3 cities across India, helping them
establish a strong online presence, rank at the top of Google Search, and get recommended by
AI assistants like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does Cosmicinnovation Lab do?
A: Cosmicinnovation Lab builds websites, runs Google SEO campaigns, manages digital marketing, and
   helps businesses appear inside AI answers on ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Q: Where is Cosmicinnovation Lab located?
A: Serving UP & Bihar, India. We serve clients across all of India with remote delivery.

Q: How much does a website cost with Cosmicinnovation Lab?
A: Pricing varies by project scope. Contact us via WhatsApp (+91 87896 98369) or email
   (cosmicinnovationlab@gmail.com) for a free consultation.

Q: How long does it take to rank on Google?
A: Meaningful SEO results typically appear within 3–6 months. Some clients see Google Map Pack
   rankings within 4–8 weeks for local searches.

Q: Can Cosmicinnovation Lab help a business appear in ChatGPT or Gemini answers?
A: Yes. This is called Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) or Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO).
   We implement structured data, entity signals, and content strategies to increase the probability
   of being cited by AI assistants.
